description: This file defines the UI theme for an Android application using Jetpack Compose, setting up dynamic color schemes based on system theme, managing system UI appearance, and providing utility functions for overlay colors.

methods.name: OpenClawTheme
methods.description: A composable function that sets up the app's theme with dynamic color schemes based on system theme and manages system bar appearance.

methods.name: overlayContainerColor
methods.description: Provides a color for overlay containers, adjusting transparency based on dark/light mode.

methods.name: overlayIconColor
methods.description: Provides a color for overlay icons based on the current theme.
